senses.gloss: m.(b. h. עֹפֶר; עפר to be thick, strong; cmp. preced., young animal; trnsf. youth, strong man.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 14:7">Gen. R. s. 14</cite> (play on <he>עפר</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 2:7">Gen. II, 7</cite>) <he>ע׳ עולם על מליאתו נברא</he> the conqueror of the world was created in his fulness (completely developed).—Pl. <he>עֳפָרִים</he>. Y’lamd. to Num. XXIII, 10, quot. in Ar. (play on <cite ref="P01076"><he>עֲפַר</he></cite>, Num. l. c.) <he>מי מנה ע׳ וכ׳</he> who will count the youths among them that have reached the age of marriage &c.?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 766:6">Yalk. Num. 766</cite> <he>כמה ע׳ יש וכ׳</he> how many are the youths in Israel that study the Law &c.! (Tanna d’bé El. ch. XXI <he>עפר</he>, corr. acc.).
